name: facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontexts/downstream/semseg/datasets/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.create_infsampler: create an InfSampler to infinitely sample elements from a dataset with optional shuffling
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.create_distributed_infsampler: create a DistributedInfSampler to partition infinite sampling across distributed training replicas and ranks
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.reset_permutation_infsampler: reset the permutation of an InfSampler to reshuffle or resequence the data source
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.use_infsampler_next: use the next method of InfSampler to get the next sample index from the dataset
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.review_distributed_infsampler: review the DistributedInfSampler class to understand how it partitions samples across GPU replicas

facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.initialize_data_loader: create a PyTorch DataLoader for a voxelization dataset class with configurable augmentation, transforms, and distributed sampling
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.VoxelizationDataset: build a PyTorch dataset class that loads RGB point clouds, voxelizes them, and applies coordinate and feature augmentation
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.VoxelizationDatasetBase_load_ply: load a PLY point cloud file and extract coordinates, RGB features, and semantic labels as numpy arrays
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.VoxelizationDataset_convert_mat2cfl: convert a raw numpy matrix of point cloud data into separate coordinates, features, and labels arrays
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.DatasetPhase: convert between dataset phase enum values and their string representations for train, val, test, and debug phases

facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.create_scannet_dataset: create a ScannetVoxelizationDataset instance with config, transforms, augmentation, and dataset phase for semantic segmentation training
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.load_scannet_data: load point cloud coordinates, features, and labels from a ScanNet scene file by index using load_data
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.augment_location_feature: augment a point cloud by appending a scaled location feature column using _augment_locfeat
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.save_upsampled_features: save upsampled point cloud features mapped back to the original point cloud space using save_features
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.map_to_original_pointcloud: map voxelized coordinates back to the original point cloud using inverse transformation and KNN via get_original_pointcloud

facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.create_stanford_dataset: create a StanfordArea5Dataset instance with config, transforms, and augmentation for 3D semantic segmentation
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.load_ply_pointcloud: load a PLY point cloud file and return coordinates, features, and semantic labels
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.test_pointcloud_evaluation: test full point cloud evaluation by joining room predictions and computing per class IoU
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.augment_coords_to_feats: augment point cloud coordinates by centering and concatenating normalized coords to features
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.create_stanford_variant_dataset: create a Stanford variant dataset like Area53cm or Area510cm with custom voxel size and clip bound

facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.load_camera_extrinsics: load camera extrinsics from a text file and return a 4x4 numpy matrix
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.load_camera_intrinsics: load camera intrinsics from a text file and return focal length, principal point, and baseline
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.load_depth_map: load a depth map PNG file and return a numpy array of depth values in centimeters
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.load_semantic_label: load a ground truth semantic segmentation label PNG and return class IDs as a numpy array
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.create_voxelization_dataset: create a SynthiaVoxelizationDataset with configurable voxel size, augmentation, and data split for 3D semantic segmentation

facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.apply_chromatic_translation_augmentation: apply random color translation augmentation to sparse tensor features using ChromaticTranslation
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.apply_chromatic_autocontrast_augmentatio: apply auto contrast augmentation to sparse tensor RGB features using ChromaticAutoContrast
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.apply_chromatic_jitter_augmentation: apply random Gaussian noise jitter to sparse tensor RGB features using ChromaticJitter
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.apply_hue_saturation_augmentation: apply hue and saturation translation augmentation to RGB features using HueSaturationTranslation
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.compose_transform_pipeline: compose multiple augmentation transforms into a single pipeline using the Compose class
